item.title: How to Use ngOnChanges in Angular
item.description: The ngOnChanges lifecycle hook in Angular is called whenever input properties of a component change. As the creator of CoreUI, I use ngOnChanges to react to parent component data changes and trigger appropriate responses in child components. This hook provides detailed information about what changed, including previous and current values.
